race.description: Jarrod Arentz Electrical & Solar Solutions Mdn Plate
race.comment: CELTIC SPY (3) brings Warwick Farm form back to easier company, with his heavy-track 12th before the spell best assessed around the wide run, while his earlier third to Lord Horatio reads well for this. MAGNA SENTENTIA (6) was a genuine eye-catcher on debut at Hamilton, finishing strongly for second after being bumped at the start, and natural improvement keeps him right in the argument. CARNEVALE (2) placed first-up at Seymour and has blinkers going on. He should come on nicely and be figuring in the finish.  KING KORUNA (5) made nice improvement second up at Mildura when firmly in commission and can progress again, he maps for a soft run.
